nodes.question: Compared with the source image, is at least one frog visibly placed inside the toilet bowl?
nodes.criteria: Pass if at least one frog is visibly placed inside the toilet bowl. Fail if the images clearly show no frog placed inside the bowl. Unknown if the bowl or any apparent frog placement cannot be determined from the images. Do not treat frogs elsewhere, or other unrelated edits, as making this requested placement incomplete; the instruction specifies no count or exclusion of other placements.
nodes.binding: Compare the source and edited images. Use the source toilet to identify the bowl and determine whether a visible frog has been placed inside it. Assess only the requested bowl placement; do not infer additional placement requirements from frogs elsewhere.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

Do not treat those extra placements as negating the requested bowl placement; instead, inspect how this decision is mapped to the aggregate completion label and whether a separate completeness criterion is needed to distinguish progress from full completion. Preserve the node’s source-versus-edited comparison and its unknown state for genuinely indeterminate placement.
